body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2009') -- <Visual News> orbitsound(www.orbitsound.co.uk) presented its mobile stereo speaker 'T3' at the CES 2009, which uses amazing airSOUND single-point-stereo technology.

The orbitsound T3 is also the perfect portable stereo speaker system for laptops, music and video players. Measuring just 102 x 60 x 20mm (22mm at maximum) and weighing 115g, the T3 is powered by a lithium rechargeable battery, providing up to 10 hours playing time on a single charge.
